**Finding: compliant** (ASSIGN — Assignment and change of control)

Section 24 sits at our **preferred** position on every material term:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; only prompt notice and assignee assumption are required.
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Residual assignments are subject to a mutual consent standard qualified by "not unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed."
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service, plus a cooperation obligation for successor administration.

Cross-checks: Section 9 contains no change-of-control or assignment-linked termination trigger against us, and 9.2 confirms a lawful reorganization is not itself grounds for termination. Section 13 permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 permitted assignment, so the M&A carve-out is not undercut by the licence grant.

No redline proposed.
